words: Days since last deposit. It sets the win-back tier: 7+, 14+ or 30+.
An inactive player who deposits again after you contacted them. It only counts if your logged contact came before the deposit.
A responsible-gaming flag, or a risk tag meaning abuse or fraud (not the days-since-deposit "at risk" label). Either one: route to welfare, never marketing.
Where every contact is logged with its time. It proves the contact came before the deposit.
KPI Scoring weights each reactivation by how long the player was idle: 1 to 6 days 0.10, 7 to 13 days 0.50, 14 to 29 days 0.75, 30+ days 1.00.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Does this reactivation count?
items: No RG flag and no abuse or fraud tag
Your contact was logged before the deposit
The player has not already been counted this month
tour.done: All three: record it. The most recent contact owns the count.
tour.notYet: Deposit before any contact: no credit. Flagged player: welfare, not marketing.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five steps
items: Daily, inactive VIPs by DSLD (7+, 14+, 30+). Remove RG and abuse or fraud flagged players.

Early 7+: gentle check-in. 14+: stronger win-back. 30+: deep win-back. Risk Push runs as its own campaign; a reactivation counts whether it came from a campaign or your own approach, as long as your contact came first.
Log the contact. It must come before any redeposit.
Use the Bonus Issuance and Approval SOP. Never size it yourself.
Credit only if your contact came first. One count per player per month.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Claim a reactivation without a logged contact before the deposit.
Market to an RG or abuse/fraud flagged player.
Count the same player twice in a month.

tour.label: Who counts
tour.title: Two of you contacted the same player
tour.q: Did more than one CS contact the player before they deposited?
tour.yes: The most recent contact before the deposit owns the count. One count only.
tour.no: Your logged contact owns it, if it came before the deposit.

pool.q: A 20-day inactive player deposited at 1 PM. You contacted them at 3 PM. Do you get the reactivation?
o: No; contact must come before the deposit
pool.why: Contact precedes deposit. A deposit before any logged contact earns no reactivation credit.

pool.q: A 30+ day player has an RG flag. What do you do?
pool.why: RG or risk flag beats everything: welfare, never marketing.

pool.q: You contacted a player on Monday; a teammate contacted them on Wednesday; they deposited Thursday. Who owns the count?
o: Your teammate, the most recent contact
pool.why: One count per player per month; the most recent contact before the deposit owns it.

pool.q: The player came back and deposited. How do you size their bonus?
o: Follow the Bonus Issuance and Approval SOP (SW cap, ladder)
pool.why: Size any bonus via the Bonus SOP. Do not free-size.

pool.q: A player you reactivated on the 5th lapsed and came back on the 25th after you contacted them again. How many counts this month?
pool.why: One reactivation count per player per month.

pool.q: Which approach fits an early win-back player (DSLD 7+)?
pool.why: Early win-back (7+) is a gentle check-in; 14+ stronger; 30+ deep win-back.
